text: More people have died from COVID-19 vaccines than from the COVID-19 virus.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.questionWording: More people have died from the COVID-19 vaccines than have died from the COVID-19 virus
room.note: 47% definitely false. KFF also reports 14% who had both heard the claim and believe it; this grid uses the share of all adults who call it definitely or probably true.

truthSource.label: CDC COVID Data Tracker
truthSource.oneLine: CDC counts more than 1.1 million U.S. COVID-19 deaths, while deaths causally linked to the vaccines number in the single digits to low dozens.
